createTable.remarks: A Retailer whose Feeds are ingested, keyed by the same id as in HowiBuy

column.name: id
column.remarks: The primary key, the id of the Retailer's service account in the IDM

column.name: name
column.remarks: The name

createTable.remarks: One of a Retailer's e-shops, serving one country with its own assortment and prices

column.name: id
column.remarks: The primary key, a short stable code chosen by us, identical in HowiBuy, e.g. 'rimi-lt'

column.name: retailer_id
column.remarks: The Retailer owning this Catalogue

column.name: country
column.remarks: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country served, e.g. 'LT'

column.name: primary_language
column.remarks: ISO 639-1 code of the language every listed product must be named in, e.g. 'lt'

column.name: active
column.remarks: Whether Feeds are accepted for this Catalogue

createTable.remarks: The receipt and processing of one Feed of a Catalogue

column.name: id
column.remarks: The primary key

column.name: catalogue_id
column.remarks: The Catalogue the Feed is for

column.name: feed_type
column.remarks: SNAPSHOT, DELTA or DELETION

column.name: status
column.remarks: RECEIVED, PROCESSING, HELD, DONE, FAILED or DISCARDED

column.name: adapter
column.remarks: The adapter that parses the Feed; null until processing starts

column.name: adapter_version
column.remarks: The version of the adapter; null until processing starts

column.name: received_at
column.remarks: When the Feed was stored

column.name: started_at
column.remarks: When processing started; null until then

column.name: finished_at
column.remarks: When processing finished; null until then

column.name: file_path
column.remarks: Where the gzip-compressed Feed is stored, relative to the directory of the feed store

column.name: file_size
column.remarks: The size of the Feed as received, before compression, in bytes

column.name: file_sha256
column.remarks: The SHA-256 of the Feed as received, before compression, in lowercase hex

column.name: count_total
column.remarks: The records read from the Feed; the counts are null until processing finishes

column.name: count_valid
column.remarks: The records that passed validation

column.name: count_rejected
column.remarks: The records rejected, listed in IN_INGESTION_REJECT

column.name: count_added
column.remarks: The records new to the Catalogue

column.name: count_changed
column.remarks: The records that changed a Retailer Product or its Listing

column.name: count_unchanged
column.remarks: The records that changed nothing

column.name: count_deactivated
column.remarks: The Listings taken off sale

column.name: error
column.remarks: Why the run failed; null otherwise

createTable.remarks: A record of a Feed that was not applied, and why

column.name: ingestion_run_id
column.remarks: The Ingestion Run that read the record

column.name: position
column.remarks: Where the record is in the Feed, counting the records from 1

column.name: product_key
column.remarks: The product key of the record; null if it could not be read

column.name: reason
column.remarks: Why the record was rejected

changeSet.author: nikospara
changeSet.comment: The realm's development Retailer, Lime Fresh, whose id is the id of its service account in the tealhelix realm, the same as in HowiBuy's TH_RETAILER. It gets one Catalogue to ingest into.
